title: Creating a shift and sending offers
subtitle: One step from new shift to offers sent

captions.text: Choose the venue and role. The address fills in from the venue.
Set the date, start and end times and the break.
Select the staff to offer the shift to.
Select Send Offer. Crewflow creates the shift and sends each offer.
Two offers were sent. Sam Reed already has a confirmed shift at that time, so no offer was sent.
